title: The Forge Bell
text: An iron bell that once called a thousand smiths to work hangs over the ruined gate, silent for an age. Its rope is still there, frayed to threads. Rust weeps from its lip like tears. Some say the smiths still answer it.

outcomes.text: The ghosts of the smiths rise to work, and make you something.
Something else rises to the call.

options.label: The strongest takes the bell for its bronze.

outcomes.text: The rope sways as you pass. Somewhere deep in the halls a hammer starts up anyway, and the Leader's armour rings in answer. By morning its dents are gone.

options.label: The one in plate rings it.

outcomes.text: The bell's voice goes through the halls and through the plate, and every hammer in the dark answers. By morning the plate is better than its maker left it.
